reviews.comment: Dr Olson has been my fav prof by far that I have had at TAMU. He truly cares both about the subject that he is teaching and passing that passion to his students. HIs lectures were interesting and there wasn't a time that I just dreaded going to class. He won't be a prof here at tamu anymore, but I highly suggest taking one of his classes wherever!

I loved Olson! He was so sweet and you could tell he really liked what he taught. Only assignments are work for a group project throughout the semester, it is graded kind've hard so make sure to put work into it. He cancels class or makes it asynchronous a lot so there aren't a lot of in class days but his lectures are interesting

His lectures are interesting and the assigned group project is actually fun if you happen to get a good group. Overall, one of my favorite profs at TAMU. He genuinely cares about you and your career, especially for the advertising students. If you are creative and enjoy analyzing commercials and even coming up with some yourself, take this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my fav profs ever! He is so nice and really cares about students and makes his class interactive & fun! You work on 1 huge group project throughout the whole semester and it's very intense but rewarding(would be better in person) Tests are from his lecture vids and textbook so actually read it! Pray you get a good group, we met 2x a week min
